Alex Freeman.note: Freeman has already given United States a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Alex Freeman.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为United States贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Alex Zendejas.summary: Álex Zendejas is a United States right winger from América who gives the national team left-footed service, box arrivals, and Liga MX sharpness.
Alex Zendejas.note: Zendejas is an attacking change-up for United States. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Alex Zendejas.noteZh: 他是United States的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Antonee Robinson.note: Robinson is in the quiet-work part of United States's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Antonee Robinson.noteZh: 他是United States主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Auston Trusty.note: Trusty has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Türkiye. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Auston Trusty.noteZh: 他已经为United States进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Brenden Aaronson.note: Aaronson gives United States a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Brenden Aaronson.noteZh: 他是United States的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Chris Brady.note: Brady sits behind the starter for United States, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Chris Brady.noteZh: 他给United States保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Chris Richards.note: Richards has been part of United States's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Chris Richards.noteZh: 他在United States体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Christian Pulisic.note: Pulisic has one tournament assist in the bank for United States. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Christian Pulisic.noteZh: 他已经帮United States制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Cristian Roldan.note: Roldan gives United States a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Cristian Roldan.noteZh: 他是United States的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Folarin Balogun.note: Balogun has been one of United States's real scoring stories, with goals against Paraguay and Bosnia and Herzegovina. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Folarin Balogun.noteZh: 他让United States拥有一个必须被惦记的得分点。每个松散球都可能突然变重。

Giovanni Reyna.note: Reyna's World Cup has already included a goal against Paraguay. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Giovanni Reyna.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Haji Wright.note: Wright is attacking depth for United States. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Haji Wright.noteZh: 他是United States前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Joe Scally.note: Scally is defensive cover for United States's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Joe Scally.noteZh: 他是United States在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Malik Tillman.note: Tillman has given United States both the finish and the pass, including goals against Bosnia and Herzegovina and Belgium. That double threat is why defenders cannot settle on one answer.
Malik Tillman.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经同时给United States带来终结和传球。防守者不能只防他的一种选择。

Mark McKenzie.summary: Mark McKenzie is a United States centre-back from Toulouse who gives the national team recovery defending, clean passing, and aerial control.
Mark McKenzie.note: McKenzie is back-line insurance for United States. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Mark McKenzie.noteZh: 他给United States那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Matt Freese.note: Freese has carried the keeper minutes for United States. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Matt Freese.noteZh: 他是United States防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Matt Turner.note: Turner gives United States a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Matt Turner.noteZh: 他在United States首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Max Arfsten.note: Arfsten is the forward United States can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Max Arfsten.noteZh: 他给United States替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Miles Robinson.note: Robinson gives United States cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Miles Robinson.noteZh: 他是United States后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Ricardo Pepi.note: Pepi gives United States a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Ricardo Pepi.noteZh: 他是United States在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Sebastian Berhalter.note: Berhalter has both scored and created for United States in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Sebastian Berhalter.noteZh: 他给United States展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Sergino Dest.note: Dest gives United States one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Sergino Dest.noteZh: 他是United States无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Tim Ream.note: Ream gives United States one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Tim Ream.noteZh: 他是United States无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Timothy Weah.note: Weah is the kind of defender United States can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Timothy Weah.noteZh: 他是United States艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Tyler Adams.note: Adams is a tempo player for United States. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Tyler Adams.noteZh: 他让United States在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Weston McKennie.note: McKennie has been one of United States's midfield connectors in this tournament. He keeps the next pass alive and helps the team avoid rushed choices.
Weston McKennie.noteZh: 他是United States让控球不散掉的球员之一。看点是他多早就知道下一脚传给谁。
